name: implement
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the model-backed implement-then-PR doer (DESIGN §3.6.2/§3.6.3) replaces the dry-run reference adapter, or when the Handoff schema reaches a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: FT-A (DESIGN §3.6.3): make IMPLEMENT the deterministic correctness gate. Ship src/test_gate.py — a self-contained script (no rabbit-framework runtime dependency) that runs a target feature's test/run.py via subprocess and records a machine-checkable verdict {feature, passed, returncode, summary} to a known artifact path. Add validate_handoff() to implement.py: an opened handoff is valid only with a passing SCRIPT-produced test_verdict; a missing/failing verdict is invalid. Update ship/agents/auto-maintainer-implementer.md so the accept path invokes the gate after committing and may only report status:opened with the passing verdict embedded (the pass is the script's recorded result, never the model's prose; #255 lesson). spec.md/contract.md document the gate, the test_verdict field, and the predicate; e2e tests prove pass/fail recording and predicate rejection.
spec_no_change_reason: DOC-dimension measured-reduction housekeep wave: coding-rules §6 verify-or-flag pass applied to docs/spec.md + docs/contract.md. Every path ref (ship/agents/auto-maintainer-implementer.md), cross-feature ref (adapter-wiring, scheduling.run_tick, safety-governance), and behaviour claim verified LIVE via find/grep/ls; no proven-dead content found. Honest verdict: no-op (already-clean), a valid PASS. No spec body change; the wave ships the gating housekeep e2e test + baseline fixture only.
